context: You said a backtest needs far more data. The price-ta lane is finding sources with a lot of history and will bring new options.

options.gain: No spend and no download. A firmer answer before anything touches pricing.
options.how: The daily price job keeps collecting. Re-test the sealed signal at about a dozen windows.
options.label: Wait for more data
options.lose: The sealed signal stays unused until then.

options.gain: A chance to test whole sets from launch, not only cards you stocked.
options.how: Read its site to see whether it carries Riftbound and how big its daily files are, then ask you before any download.
options.label: Check TCGCSV first
options.lose: One more download decision for you, and the coverage may come to nothing.

options.how: Sealed rows show the low-listing-vs-market gap as a hint. No price changes by itself.
options.label: Show it on Pricing now
options.lose: It rests on 3 windows. A hint that later fails misleads you.

title: Where does the price-pattern study go next?
why: 3 windows is too few to put on a pricing screen. The data arrives for free.
